title: Ask HN: Helpdesk for a 12-person SaaS?
text: We're a 12-person B2B SaaS and our two support people are drowning in tickets. Zendesk quoted us way more than we can afford. What are people using in 2026? Bonus if it can answer the repetitive how-to questions on its own.

title: Re: Intercom pricing changes
text: We just got our Intercom renewal and it doubled. Actively evaluating alternatives this month, mainly need a chat widget with an AI that answers from our docs and escalates to a person.

title: Re: How do you handle support at your startup?
text: Honestly the founders answer every email. 70% are the same five questions about billing and exports. Would love something that handles those automatically but we haven't found anything that doesn't hallucinate.

title: Show HN: I built an open-source AI support chatbot
text: After six months of work I'm launching my AI chatbot for customer support. It plugs into your docs and answers questions. Free tier available, feedback welcome!

title: Re: Who is hiring? (November)
text: Looking for work: senior customer support specialist, 8 years experience with Zendesk and Freshdesk, remote, EU timezone.

title: Ask HN: Best way to automate tier-1 support for our Shopify store?
text: We run a Shopify store with about 3k orders a month. Most tickets are 'where is my order' and returns. Looking to buy a tool that can answer these 24/7 and pass the tricky ones to our team.

title: Re: LLM hallucinations in production
text: Interesting paper on retrieval-augmented generation reducing hallucinations by 40% on benchmark X. The evaluation methodology section is worth reading.

title: Re: Freshdesk vs Help Scout
text: We're 40 people, mostly support for a fintech app. Freshdesk's AI add-on gives wrong answers about our fees. We need something grounded in our own policy pages, and we'd switch this quarter.

title: My weekend project: a Discord bot that answers questions about my game
text: Built a fun little bot with an LLM for my indie game's Discord. It answers lore questions. Code on GitHub.

title: Ask HN: Anyone using AI agents for customer service at scale?
text: I'm the head of CX at a 150-person logistics SaaS. We get 10k tickets a month. Leadership wants us to pilot an AI agent with human handoff in Q1. What vendors should I talk to?

title: Re: Customer support is broken
text: Every company's support is terrible now. I waited 40 minutes on hold with my bank yesterday. Rant over.

title: We're hiring a Support Engineer
text: Acme Analytics (30 people) is hiring a support engineer to handle our growing ticket queue. We're also open to tooling that reduces the load.

title: Re: Building a RAG pipeline
text: For our internal wiki search we used pgvector and BM25 with reciprocal rank fusion, works great. Happy to share the code.

title: Re: Zendesk alternatives
text: I'm a consultant who sets up Zendesk for clients, DM me if you need help migrating.

title: Ask HN: How do you keep support quality when going international?
text: Our e-commerce brand (25 people) is expanding to Spain and Germany. We can't hire native speakers for every language yet. Looking for a way to answer customers in their language without wrong answers about shipping and returns.

title: Re: AI will replace support jobs
text: I think AI support agents are overhyped and customers hate them. Nobody wants to talk to a bot.

title: Re: Tools you'd pay for
text: I'd pay today for a support bot that reads our Notion help center, answers in chat and creates a ticket in Linear when it can't. We're a 9-person dev tools startup.

title: Student project: chatbot for my university
text: For my thesis I'm building a chatbot that answers questions about course registration. Any tips on evaluation?

title: Re: Gorgias experience?
text: We left Gorgias because the AI replies kept promising refunds we don't offer. Now back to manual replies and the team is burning out. Any grounded alternatives?

title: Launch: Examplify AI raises $20M Series A
text: Examplify AI (a fictional example) announced a $20M round to expand its AI customer-service platform to Europe.
